describe.summary: Leaves the owner tasks that act on nothing, so that everything around a task can be tested.

prepare.doc: Opens one task for the owner of the row the run names, and answers `awaiting_owner` with its id and hash.

params.name: title
params.doc: The task's title, 80 characters at most. `Tasks probe` when it is not named.

params.name: body
params.doc: Shown as the field `Body`, sealed in the task's state, and handed back in the result.

params.name: kind
params.doc: `confirm` (when it is not named), `text` or `file`: what the owner answers with.

params.name: answer_by
params.doc: The operation that answers a `confirm` task, and the only one that may: `confirm` (when it is not named), `confirm_slow`, `confirm_silent` or `confirm_trap`. A `text` or `file` task is answered by `supply`.

params.name: life_seconds
params.doc: How long the task waits; 86400 at most, and that long when it is not named.

params.name: files
params.doc: `{name, content_type, text, repeat}`: a file of `text` written `repeat` times.

params.name: again
params.doc: `supply` opens the next task of the conversation when it answers this one.

prepare_many.doc: Opens `count` tasks in one run, each as `prepare` makes it, and stops at the first refusal: answers the tasks opened, and the refusal's code and the number of the task refused.

params.name: count
params.doc: How many tasks to open, 1 to 10.

params.name: title
params.doc: The task's title, 80 characters at most. `Tasks probe` when it is not named.

params.name: body
params.doc: Shown as the field `Body`, sealed in the task's state, and handed back in the result.

params.name: kind
params.doc: `confirm` (when it is not named), `text` or `file`: what the owner answers with.

params.name: answer_by
params.doc: The operation that answers a `confirm` task, and the only one that may: `confirm` (when it is not named), `confirm_slow`, `confirm_silent` or `confirm_trap`. A `text` or `file` task is answered by `supply`.

params.name: life_seconds
params.doc: How long the task waits; 86400 at most, and that long when it is not named.

params.name: files
params.doc: `{name, content_type, text, repeat}`: a file of `text` written `repeat` times.

params.name: again
params.doc: `supply` opens the next task of the conversation when it answers this one.

prepare_raw.doc: Opens a `confirm` task whose display is handed to the host as the call spells it.

params.name: display
params.doc: `{title, fields: [{label, kind, value | values}]}`.

params.name: state
params.doc: Sealed beside the task and handed back when it is answered.

params.name: answer_by
params.doc: The operation the task names, as given; `confirm` when it is not named.

params.name: life_seconds
params.doc: How long the task waits; 86400 at most.

confirm.doc: The owner answers a task that names `confirm`, and reports what was prepared: the task ends `done`.

params.name: task_id
params.doc: The task answered.

params.name: task_hash
params.doc: The hash of what the owner's page opened.

confirm_slow.doc: The owner answers a task that names `confirm_slow`, the run waits `seconds`, then reports what was prepared: the task is `answering` for that long and ends `done`.

params.name: task_id
params.doc: The task answered.

params.name: task_hash
params.doc: The hash of what the owner's page opened.

params.name: seconds
params.doc: How long the run waits before it reports, 1 to 170.

supply.doc: The owner answers a `text` or `file` task and reports what was supplied; a task prepared with `again` opens the next one.

params.name: task_id
params.doc: The task answered.

params.name: task_hash
params.doc: The hash of what the owner's page opened.

params.name: supplied
params.doc: What the owner supplies, sealed to the task's reply key, in base64.

confirm_silent.doc: The owner answers a task that names `confirm_silent` or `confirm`, and reports nothing: the task ends `failed`.

params.name: task_id
params.doc: The task answered.

params.name: task_hash
params.doc: The hash of what the owner's page opened.

confirm_trap.doc: The owner answers a task that names `confirm_trap` or `confirm`, reports, and traps: the task ends `failed`.

params.name: task_id
params.doc: The task answered.

params.name: task_hash
params.doc: The hash of what the owner's page opened.

task_status.doc: One task this caller made: its state, and the result, the reason and the run when it has them.

params.name: task_id
params.doc: A task this caller made.

task_cancel.doc: Withdraws an open task this caller made.

params.name: task_id
params.doc: A task this caller made.

task_delete.doc: Deletes a task this caller made, in any state.

params.name: task_id
params.doc: A task this caller made.

tasks.doc: The tasks this caller made in this project for this owner; an empty list when there are none.

tasks_unlock.doc: The owner's run writes the copies of the open tasks for the device now in force, and answers how many wait.
